name: Obsidian shared memory
description: Syncs a shared agent memory folder through Obsidian Sync (Obsidian Headless) and tells every agent turn where it is, so agents on all your machines read and add to the same notes.
longDescription: Runs a shared memory folder through Obsidian Headless so every p0code machine reads and writes the same notes. Agents get the folder's location in each turn and can add to it without a separate sync client.
